name: West Virginia
status_why: Clarity answered scripts; the kit already reads it.
office: the West Virginia Secretary of State
system: Clarity Elections (Scytl) at results.enr.clarityelections.com/WV/, the Secretary of State's results site; all 55 counties report into it.

results_page.label: West Virginia Secretary of State: election results

election.how_to_find: sos.wv.gov's results page in late October.

feeds.updates: A new version on each upload on election night.

races_in_feed: Federal, legislature, judges (nonpartisan, in May), county commission, county row offices and others on the November ballot; municipal elections are separate.
local: No: counties are inside the same Clarity site.
how_counted: Counties report their counts through the night.
count_order: Clarity detail XML likely carries vote types; confirm in a detail file.
vote_types: Likely: Clarity detail XML carries VoteType elements (West Virginia counts early, absentee and election day ballots; 2024 turnout was reported as 418,850 election day, 310,878 early, 24,404 absentee). Confirm in a detailxml.

certify.body: the Governor of West Virginia, on the counties' certificates
certify.rule: Members of Congress: the Governor proclaims the results after the counties' certificates arrive, within 30 days of the election (W. Va. Code 3-6-11); state officers and legislators are declared by the Legislature.
certify.local_rule: County boards meet on the fifth day after, excluding Sundays (3-6-9).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
